notice: Fictional sample data for demonstration. Lantern Bay, Bayside County and every company, date, number and quote in these documents are made up.

observations.quote: The certificate for reporting year 2025 was due on March 31, 2026 and is marked not received.
A reminder notice was sent to the owner on April 2, 2026.
Under Section 5.1 of the agreement, the affordability period ends on December 31, 2026.

story: Signed in 2011 for 15 years. The 2024 yearly certificate shows 9 of 9 homes leased. The 2025 certificate is marked not received, and the affordability period ends on December 31, 2026.

claims.quote: By Resolution No. 2011-18, the City approved a 15-year partial property tax exemption for the Project.
The Owner shall reserve 9 of the 60 homes in the Project as Affordable Homes.
Each Affordable Home shall be leased to a household with income at or below 50 percent of Area Median Income.
Monthly rent for each Affordable Home shall not exceed 30 percent of 50 percent of Area Median Income, adjusted for household size.
claims.value: 30 percent of 50 percent of area median income

claims.quote: The Affordability Period begins on January 1, 2012 and ends on December 31, 2026.
claims.review_note: The end date is less than two months after this sample was made.

claims.quote: The Owner is responsible for compliance with this Agreement, and this Agreement binds every later owner of the Project.
The Owner shall deliver an annual compliance certificate to the City by March 31 of each year.
If a default is not cured within 30 days after written notice from the City, the Owner shall repay the property taxes exempted during the period of default.
claims.value: Repay exempted taxes after 30-day cure period

claims.quote: This certificate is submitted under Section 7.1 of the Agreement for reporting year 2024.
As of December 31, 2024, 9 of the 9 required Affordable Homes were leased to income-qualified households.
All 9 households in Affordable Homes had incomes at or below 50 percent of Area Median Income when last certified.
claims.value: At or below 50 percent of area median income

claims.quote: No Affordable Home was charged rent above the limit in Section 4.3 during the reporting year.
claims.value: No rent above the Section 4.3 limit
